comments.body: The reason for this issue is that `pyangbind` publish a new version 0.6.0 at 2017-08-16 which introduces a new dependency (`six`). I'll modify dockerfile and explicitly install `pyangbind` version 0.5.10 to avoid this issue.

linkedPullRequests.title: [translate-acl] Specify pyangbind version to avoid introducing new dependency
